task_name: Fix round 1: graph test strength (F-012, F-013, F-021)
description: Strengthened the tests of graphLayout.ts and RelationshipGraph.tsx so that all 22 surviving mutants of review round 1 are killed; no production file changed. F-021 (Y1-Y9, Y12, Y16, Y18): new layout fixtures for a root self-loop, a second-step node touching a hidden and a drawn first-step neighbour, a node reachable only through a second-step node, edge widths for counts 1, 16 and 2^20, a neighbour whose largest count is not on its last edge, a fitting asymmetric layout centred in the box, a non-integer column cap, a zero/negative text scale, and colour parsing of 3/4-digit hex, percentage channels and alpha, and an out-of-range alpha. F-012 (G5, G9): the viewport container is given a size in the DOM test (clientWidth/clientHeight stubbed on the element), Fit is checked against computeViewport's zoom and pan; on a zero-sized container a user viewport survives Fit; the zoom levels the component requests on the cytoscape seam are recorded and never leave 0.3..2.5. F-013 (G1-G4, G7, G8, G10, G11): an overflow entry with an invalid side asks for nothing; hovering a node fades all but its closed neighbourhood and captions, highlights the neighbourhood and sets a pointer cursor, mouseout clears both; hovering '+N more' shows a pointer and fades nothing; a file-kind root gets border width 2 while a file neighbour keeps 1; an edge between two non-root nodes carries the second-step class; changing data-palette alone (token values from a stylesheet, no style attribute change) re-colours labels in place; a prefers-color-scheme change (matchMedia stubbed) re-colours labels and the listener is removed on unmount.

notes: Reproduction: every finding reproduced (the 22 mutants survived on the previous tests per mutation-1-compact.txt), and each new test was confirmed in the scratch copy to fail under its mutant. suggested_fix diverged: F-012 — besides stubbing the size and asserting Fit's zoom and pan, G5 is killed by a zero-sized Fit after the test sets a non-default viewport: with the initial viewport (zoom 1, pan 0) the mutant writes the same values and is equivalent, so the suggested sized-Fit assertion alone would not kill it. G9: cytoscape clamps zoom to its own minZoom/maxZoom options, so an assertion on cy.zoom() after repeated Zoom in would not kill the mutant either; the test records the levels the component requests on the seam (allowed by the dispatch). F-013 — data-palette is flipped with token values from a <style> sheet rather than style.setProperty, because a root style-attribute change also triggers the observer and would hide the G4 mutant; the colour-scheme listener is pinned with a stubbed matchMedia. F-021 — Y7 needs an asymmetric layout (root plus one long neighbour) because a lone root's bounds centre equals the root and the mutant is equivalent there; Y12 is pinned by textScale 0 and -2 laying out exactly like the default. In AC3's sense the drawn-anchor fixture puts the hidden anchor on the outgoing side and the drawn one on the incoming side, so the choice is visible as the node's side.
